scope: Direct full-module source-context review. All inventoried sites linked to human-readable contexts with native AST outcomes/operators retained. T temporal/state/order, P price/priority, N declaration/other. Context review not runtime proof.

contexts.meaning: Native primary records distinguish immutable physical Order, logical point, MBL, exact transition and mutable aggregate result. Bearish is default; no temporal transition at declaration.

Resolve confirmed physical PH through last main index, number exactly 3 only. Search strictly later above price; optional truthy cross callback. Earliest event wins, then source index, cycle id or empty; default null.
Resolve confirmed physical PL3, search strictly later below price; same tie key; target bearish.
Delegate physical reconciliation for highs or lows with explicit decision-index horizon and direction of improvement; no logical state mutation.
Map cycles by encounter order, group only points decision_index<=horizon by physical index/time. Sort groups by earliest exact decision then source time/index; no future role renames earlier horizon.

Earliest role identity by decision event, cycle order, cycle id, trigger index, number. Winner greatest number then same key. Strict progressive extreme vs preceding final price raises final number at least prior+1; equality no increment. Copy winner with earliest identity source, no local mutation.
Build physical source-time labels, later duplicate overwrites; delegate relabel audit causes and copy Order.

Iterate cycles or singleton fallback. Require MBL and trigger index<=horizon. Choose direction's primary points, earliest exact decision among decision indexes<=horizon. Yield only after actual primary confirmation, not activation alone.
Remove visible StopAll only for physical source identity promoted by confirmed primary decision index<=horizon. Original historical list unchanged.
PH gate confirmation>=event; First unrestricted. All other kinds require First index>=gate and confirmation>event. No common symmetric gate.
Strict crossing starts upper_bound(event), selects first greater/less on [left,lower length); no same-time hit, no main fallback. Map lower timestamp with clamp true; null absent.
Source extreme over full main positions [left,right] inclusive; first min/max tie retained. Empty raises; does not clip to lower event.
StopAll occupies source main indexes, exclude S/E at occupied index or exact Boolean false validity. Input event kind rank StopAll0,S1,E2.
Sort source time,kind rank,index; dedup kind,index,time. StopAll resets owner/confirmations/qualified, reference only number>=3. Other events ignored without reference or after segment qualified.

Dominance update with family lowercase and E number or S null. Same object means no advancement. Clear confirmations on first/new count1; append exact decision; armed yields reference/current and max relevant decision time.

For each seed track minimum qualification, dedup reference/second integer indexes, first strictly later crossing above reference main High. Sort activation hit,qualification,reference index,second index. Store schedule when run supplied; none activated returns waiting-for-stopall-break if qualified.

Restore retained steps in order: activation count, append/replace checkpoints; append retained points to global roles, PH promotes source and optionally invokes native callback. Refresh retained MBL stop; initial reversal from confirmed highs only.
At each iteration generate missing proposals (including null), pass current reversal event as bound. Select earliest decision by exact event and cycle index; next activation from sorted schedule.
Reversal wins when event<=next decision and <=next activation (absent unconstrained). Terminate without committing later proposals.

Otherwise activation wins decision equality; consume activation. If reference already promoted, retain skipped step if run; else activate checkpoint and append. Continue so same-time activations precede point commits.

No decision ends loop. Commit chosen proposal and append point to cycle/global lists; save step. PH promotes physical source, invokes callback when present then invalidates ALL pending proposals including null; recompute reversal even without callback. PL alone does not invalidate.

Aggregate pending result if available else committed, first MBL and last cycle status, reversed status overrides. Dedup post-PL3 Orders by direction/First/Break retaining first; sort stop event,negative First,Break.

Checkpoint stores result/reference/gate/cursor/phase/reset flag; activation identity includes exact event,index,reference/second identities and qualification, omits price. Run retains previous, dirty, schedule, steps, crossings, projections.

No previous returns current steps. Compare exact activation schedule common prefix; frontier min(dirty,first changed activation in old/new). Retain earlier steps strictly < frontier, stop at equality.

Cross key event,string level,above; current hit/null reused. Start upper_bound(event). Old nonnull hit<dirty reusable; otherwise previous key permits advance to max(original start,lower_bound(dirty)). No previous key scans full interval.
Refresh MBL strict stop after trigger via callback; null pair if absent. If unchanged return checkpoint; else copy MBL/result/checkpoint.

Activation sets cycle id and qualification; reference High; gate/cursor hit. Floor minimum full main second source..gate inclusive, first strictly later below floor stop; return PH-default checkpoint.
Prospect copies point/order lists, keeps committed checkpoint unmodified. Local phase/cursor/gates can advance on cancellation; no artificial iteration cap.

Latest PH/PL level or reference/floor; PH number resets to1 after PL or absent, PL increments. Seek strict up/down after cursor; neither waits; same exact event ambiguous. Otherwise earliest determines phase/gate.

Gate cursor>=before reversal waits. Order candidate uses PH/PL distinct gate. Continuing PH>1 needs parent-stop or reset-leg with nonnull boxTop>prior high; strict stop>confirmation. Winner min(stop,-First,Break).

Cancel below floor for PH, above high for PL. When cancel earlier than winner or winner absent or post-PL3, inspect exact RAW row; opposing strict high/floor crossing yields ambiguity before state advance.
PL number>3 no PL4. Keep eligible Orders stop strictly before cancellation; absent cancel returns post-pl3-orders-only. Otherwise advance to cancel and PH.

Equal cancel/winner stop ambiguous. Earlier cancel advances cursor; PL switches PH. PH with existing lows switches PL only when exact cancellation row Low<last PL, else seek; without lows switches PL.

No winner waits for phase Order stop. Else select full main extreme gate..winner stop inclusive; point trigger cursor, decision exact stop; prospective checkpoint moves to seek and resets high count iff PL. No native commit here.
Native resolver holds chronology/group references and optional callback; confirm_high invokes callback only if nonnull. No own mutation.

Owner bucket PH bearish else bullish, actual primary role direction-specific. For each prepared accepted Order read physical confirmation using opposite owner direction, stable dedup causes. Apply primary PH gate or secondary PL gate; nonprimary requires canonical number>0. Collect before stop filter.

Earliest parent-stop record by First,confirmation,Break selected even if not stopped. Nonprimary requires reset-leg or same record object as first direct. Require stop present and strictly >max(confirmation,event).
Create immutable StructureOrder from actual physical identity, normalized prices, native mode and deep-copied causes; return input order, no geometry synthesis.
Reflect Decimal sign using copy_negate without context rounding; reflected High=-original Low, Low=-original High.
Snapshot row references in tuple, lazy reflect; reflected price index exchanges first_less/greater with negated level, same positions/bounds.
Reflected chronology retains original time arrays, main mapping, immutable original index via adapter; time not reversed.
Reflect Order direction, stop sign and swapped nullable box prices; physical times/identity and causes unchanged.
Bullish path uses local identity cache; replace first occurrence of cycle prefix only if truthy.
Projection cache by id, previous projection reusable only if original object identical. Else swap kind, negate price/order, project identity recursively; store local/run map. No cycle detection.
Sequential status string swaps ph/pl via placeholder then reversal target; no uppercase generalization.
Project result to bullish: swap highs/lows, negate MBL price and transition level, reflect post-PL3 Orders/cycles, keep time/index and native causes; target bearish.

Order adapter maps PH to native PL and vice versa, reflects returned snapshots only; confirm_high callback gets native projected point. Adapter method always exists even if underlying callback absent. Detect bearish on reflected prices then project.
Validate trading direction; retain timeframe/main times and new run, detect once; result returns same object not copy.

Require unchanged timeframe, dirty event datetime instance. Rewind to containing old/new main open when event<main end because full decision/trigger main affects source. New run with previous and frontier; detect, clear previous, commit run/result/times only after success; external callbacks may have side effects.
